title: Multi-tenant SaaS dashboard for a legal services startup
problem: The founders had a prototype that could not handle more than one customer.
approach: rebuilt the frontend in Next.js with TypeScript
added tenant-scoped data access in the API and the database
set up role-based access and audit logging
metrics: onboarded 17 paying customers in the first quarter
cut dashboard load time from 8s to 2s

title: Checkout and subscriptions rebuild for a media store
problem: Checkout errors and a manual billing process were losing orders.
approach: rebuilt checkout with Stripe Payment Intents and webhooks
added subscription plans with proration
wrote end-to-end tests for every payment path
metrics: raised checkout conversion by 6%
cut failed payments by 20%

title: Booking platform for a fintech business
problem: Bookings came in by phone and email and were often double-booked.
approach: built a Django backend with availability rules
built a React booking widget that embeds on the existing site
sent confirmations and reminders by email and SMS
metrics: moved 62% of bookings online within two months
brought double bookings to zero over 13 weeks

title: Third-party API integration layer for a edtech platform
problem: Data from several partner systems was copied across by hand every day.
approach: designed a single integration service with retries and idempotency
normalised partner data into one schema
added monitoring for failed syncs
metrics: removed about 29 hours of manual copying per week
kept sync failures below 1%

title: GraphQL backend for a insurance mobile app
problem: The app made many slow REST calls per screen.
approach: designed a GraphQL schema around the app's screens
added batching and caching to remove repeated queries
set up auth with refresh tokens
metrics: cut API calls per screen from 11 to 2
brought p95 API latency under 202 ms

title: Fast marketing site and CMS for a media company

fixed accessibility and Core Web Vitals issues
metrics: raised Lighthouse performance from 42 to 98
grew organic traffic by 28% over three months

metrics: migrated 6 modules with no downtime
raised test coverage from 0 to 75%
